description: This file contains a utility class GeoLocationUtils that provides a method to retrieve the client's IP address from an HttpServletRequest object by checking various HTTP headers commonly used for forwarding IP addresses.

classes.name: GeoLocationUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to extract client IP address from HttpServletRequest.

methods.name: getClientIpAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the client's IP address by investigating various HTTP headers and falling back to the remote address if none of the headers contain the IP.
